name: export_chat
title: Export chat

include_transcripts.description: Voice-note transcripts in the file (default true)

media.description: Media kinds embedded in html (default audio, image, video; [] for text only)

last_n.description: Only the most recent N messages

transcribe_missing.description: First transcribe the chat's voice notes that have no transcript yet (newest first, inside from/to; Pro and above). It reaches back up to 60 days, loading older messages of the chat when WhatsApp has not loaded them, and takes up to 20 notes per call (older app versions: 10, only what is loaded). The answer's transcribe_missing says how many were transcribed, failed and are still missing; while done is false (or remaining is above 0), call again with the same arguments to go on.
